name: Allegheny Shore Cottage
shortDescription: A cozy riverfront cottage with a full kitchen and direct views of the Allegheny.
description: Wake up on the water at Allegheny Shore Cottage. This one-bedroom retreat sits right on the riverfront with a full kitchen, comfortable living space, and a fire ring just outside — perfect for morning coffee by the water and evenings under the stars.

name: Boatwatch Cottage
shortDescription: A one-bedroom cottage in Riverview Village, steps from the trail with river views.
description: Boatwatch Cottage puts you right along the trail with direct views of the river. A full kitchen, restful bedroom, and outdoor fire ring make it an easy home base for a weekend of paddling, biking, and relaxing.

name: Indigo Bend Cottage
shortDescription: A comfortable studio cottage with a kitchenette, perfect for a couple’s getaway.
description: Indigo Bend Cottage is a cozy studio in Riverview Village with a kitchenette, comfortable sleeping space, and a fire ring outside. An easy, affordable base for exploring the Armstrong Trail and the river.

name: Primitive Tent Camping
shortDescription: Simple, back-to-nature tent camping along the river. No hookups — just you and the outdoors.
description: Pitch a tent along the Allegheny at our primitive camping area. Bring your gear and enjoy fire rings, river access, and a quiet riverside setting. No electric or water hookups — true primitive camping.

name: Kayak Rentals
shortDescription: Kayak rentals are coming soon to White Rock Station.
description: We’re getting our kayak fleet ready. Soon you’ll be able to reserve and pay online, sign your waiver, and launch right from the property. Check back soon!
